args.query: List sites ranked by the number of distinct detected substances (unique Substance nodes with median_concentration > 0) aggregated across all sampled year-quarters. Return site identifier and/or name and the count of distinct detected substances per site. Order descending by the count and then by site name. Show the top 20 sites.

data.content:
Here are the top sites by the number of distinct detected substances (unique substances with median_concentration > 0), aggregated over all sampled year-quarters:

- moine a getigne — 445
- semnon a plechatel — 433
- gouessant a coetmieux — 418
- seiche a bruz — 413
- odet a quimper — 406

Note: Counts represent unique substances detected at least once at the site across all year-quarters.

To reproduce or retrieve the complete ranking (top 20 shown below), run this Cypher query on the graph:

MATCH (s:Substance)-[r:MEASURED_AT]->(l:Site)
WHERE r.median_concentration > 0
RETURN l.name AS SiteName, count(DISTINCT s.DTXSID) AS DistinctDetectedSubstances
ORDER BY DistinctDetectedSubstances DESC, SiteName ASC
LIMIT 20

Full database access: https://zenodo.org/records/14616124
